Your three lemmas are real and I did not re-derive them; I only checked the chain. Both (a) and (b) come out negative for the fiberWeilDivisor route, and then a third fact settles the probe outright.

(a) NO — and the relevant `d` is NOT the window divisor. `univSeed` is `highWindowPointwiseGeneratorSeed` -> `pointwiseGeneratorSeed` -> `ThetaGeneratorSeed.productCutter (pointwiseBaseSeed ...) ...` (Picard/DivSchemeHighWindowPointwiseGenerator.lean:76, Picard/DivSchemeSeedUnivPointwiseGenerator.lean:258/199, Picard/DivSchemeRedesignSeedUnivProduct.lean:43). Structurally, `ThetaGeneratorSeed` (Picard/DivSchemeFamily.lean:74) has NO divisor field at all — fields are `side`, `h`, `mem_basicOpen`, `sec`, `sec_mem`. The window divisor `windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi` enters only as (i) the exponent `a` and (ii) the ambient `DivCarveChartRing`/`divUniversalSeedK` submodule. The `d` the no-go quantifies over is `ThetaGeneratorSeed.localEquations` (Picard/DivSchemeFamily.lean:349): `cover.opens := D.piece` (a POINTED cover, one member per point of relCurve C RZ), `eqn z := relThetaResSide a (D.side z) (D.piece_le z) (D.sec z)` — the side component of the *chosen generator* `D.sec z` drawn from `divUniversalSeedK`, cut down further by an `exists_pointwiseAnnCutter` `Classical.choose`. So `supportLocus` is the non-unit locus of those chosen generators (Picard/SupportTube.lean:131, `(d.unitLocus)ᶜ`), not the support of `fiberWeilDivisor`.   haveI := A.invertible_thetaGlued a h

U-1 verdict: OVER-PRICED (probe answerable, but not from your route — and the answer runs opposite to what your evidence suggests). Your three lemmas are real and I did not re-derive them; I only checked the chain. Both (a) and (b) come out negative for the fiberWeilDivisor route, and then a third fact settles the probe outright.

(a) NO — and the relevant `d` is NOT the window divisor. `univSeed` is `highWindowPointwiseGeneratorSeed` -> `pointwiseGeneratorSeed` -> `ThetaGeneratorSeed.productCutter (pointwiseBaseSeed ...) ...` (Picard/DivSchemeHighWindowPointwiseGenerator.lean:76, Picard/DivSchemeSeedUnivPointwiseGenerator.lean:258/199, Picard/DivSchemeRedesignSeedUnivProduct.lean:43). Structurally, `ThetaGeneratorSeed` (Picard/DivSchemeFamily.lean:74) has NO divisor field at all — fields are `side`, `h`, `mem_basicOpen`, `sec`, `sec_mem`. The window divisor `windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi` enters only as (i) the exponent `a` and (ii) the ambient `DivCarveChartRing`/`divUniversalSeedK` submodule. The `d` the no-go quantifies over is `ThetaGeneratorSeed.localEquations` (Picard/DivSchemeFamily.lean:349): `cover.opens := D.piece` (a POINTED cover, one member per point of relCurve C RZ), `eqn z := relThetaResSide a (D.side z) (D.piece_le z) (D.sec z)` — the side component of the *chosen generator* `D.sec z` drawn from `divUniversalSeedK`, cut down further by an `exists_pointwiseAnnCutter` `Classical.choose`. So `supportLocus` is the non-unit locus of those chosen generators (Picard/SupportTube.lean:131, `(d.unitLocus)ᶜ`), not the support of `fiberWeilDivisor`.
